settings.heading: About Valoria London
settings.text: A curated destination for genuine designer fragrance, inspired by the quiet elegance of London.

settings.heading: Fragrance discovery,
settings.text:
Valoria London is a multi-brand fragrance retailer. We bring together designer fragrances from established houses and present them in one calm, considered place.

Every product page sets out the essentials: the brand, the concentration, the available sizes and, where the information is available, the notes from top to base, so you can compare fragrances with confidence.

settings.heading: An invitation to Valoria
settings.text: Be the first to discover new fragrances, exclusive releases and stories from our world.

settings.heading: The philosophy of Valoria.
settings.statement: Inspired by the timeless elegance of London, Valoria represents a modern approach to personal fragrance.
settings.text: We believe the right scent becomes part of your identity, creating impressions that words cannot always express.

settings.title: Thoughtfully selected fragrances
settings.text: A considered edit of designer fragrances, chosen for character rather than volume.

settings.title: Elegance in every detail
settings.text: From first browse to checkout, every step is designed to feel calm, clear and unhurried.

settings.title: A signature for every occasion
settings.text: Fresh daytime scents to rich evening compositions, organised so you can find yours with ease.
